title: before after hold and histogram overlay

commit.merge_subject: merge: before after hold and histogram overlay

description:
Toggleable luma histogram over the clip editor preview with a
clipping badge (owner feature list W5).

- FrameHistogram: pure 256-bin Rec.709 luma histogram from a
  rendered frame's packed ARGB. Integer weights (54R+183G+19B)>>8
  keep the per-pixel pass in int arithmetic and saturate exactly
  at 255, so pure white lands in bin 255. A strided pass reads at
  most 65,536 pixels regardless of resolution (sub-millisecond at
  source size) and defines the clip threshold's denominator.
- Clipping: luma <= 2 counts black, >= 253 counts white; the badge
  shows when either end alone reaches 0.1% of the sampled pixels
  (documented threshold, per-end so one blown highlight in a dark
  frame does not warn and the ends report independently).
- HistogramOverlay: the overlay (64dp graph, width capped at
  160dp, translucent surfaceContainerLowest scrim, bars in
